soldier: The head yellowish brown slightly tinged with smoky, mandibles reddish brown and paler on the basal third, labrum yellowish brown, antennae yellowish brown slightly tinged with smoky, pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The dorsum of the head with scattered long hairs, the labrum with eight pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on either side from the tip to the base, the periphery of the pronotum with several scattered long hairs. Head oval, widest slightly behind the middle, highest in the middle of the dorsum. Labrum tongue-shaped, its tip slightly pointed and rounded, slightly raised in the middle. The left mandible with three marginal teeth and two or three small serrate teeth above the first marginal tooth, the basal concavity with a small pointed projection; the right mandible with two small pointed projections at the base and serrate from the base to the concavity at the middle. Postmentum short, stout and raised. Antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest, the second twice the third. The anterior part of the pronotum raised, both the anterior and posterior margins concave.
taxonomy_note: The original work places this species in the genus Parahypotermes; this site now treats it under Hypotermes, the genus name having changed.
